name: Montana

period.description: Your spend down (also called incurment) is a monthly amount; you have coverage for each month you meet it.

submission.description: Meet your spend down with medical bills, or use the Cash Option and pay the amount to the state for full-month coverage, or combine both.

notes: With the Cash Option, coverage shows only after your payment is processed. Pay early if you have appointments.
Bills from the past 3 months are counted first, then insurance and Medicare premiums, then this month's bills.
If you paid the Cash Option but had fewer medical costs, you can ask for a refund of the difference.
Veterans who get Aid and Attendance cannot use the Cash Option.
